correctness.rationale: Ordered cosine four-point identity follows exactly from charge-conserving angular Fourier modes; the colored-speed four-point follows from Isserlis/Wick. Integrating the connected four-time function over three positive temporal gaps gives K4 with coefficient -21/4 and the explicit a(q),b(q,r). Algebraically positive numerators yield a(q),b(q,r)>0 for any q,r>0 and hence the unique positive quadratic root. Spectral-gap bounds justify interchanging spectral integration, temporal integration and taking the long-time rates; they also give O(1) integrated-cumulant remainders. A separate exact rational Fourier–Hermite generator calculation agrees for discrete one-, two- and three-rate mixtures, including cross terms. Finite checks are not the proof for continuous measures.
